    Lemma A.6 over any coefficient ring #

    lem:e78-traces (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex). Over any commutative coefficient ring, with a = yx³, b = yx⁴, t_j = [yx^j]:

    (1) the positive part of T₅ is spanned by t₁, t₂, t₃, t₄, [a²], [abʳ] (r ≥ 1) (span_all), with 2t₁ = 2t₃ = 0, 3t₂ = 0, 5t₄ = 0, 2[a²] = 0, 3[ab] = 0, 2[abʳ] = 0 (r ≥ 2) (t1_two, t3_two, t2_three, t4_five, a2_two, ab_three, abr_two); for nonempty W in a, b: [a²W] = 0, [abW] = -[baW], and [b^q] = 0 (q ≥ 2) (aa, ab_ba, bq);

    (2) if two is invertible, (T₅)₊ is spanned by [yx²], [yx⁴], [(yx³)(yx⁴)], annihilated by 3, 5, 3, and (T₄)₊ (impose x⁴ = 0) by [yx²], annihilated by 3 (span_two, span_two_E7).

    The proof is that of the source: the gap reductions (red0, red1, red2) lower the number of y's; a gap two between gaps of length at least three has zero trace (gap2); the identity F multiplied by x^k W gives the block relations (Fk). As usual we work with an additive map tr killing commutators and positive powers of x, y; T_m is the universal such map. The char-two-free statements in TraceE78.lean are the case two invertible.
